products.topic: Spanish Verb Conjugation Charts (Present, Past, Future)
products.etsy_title: Spanish Verb Conjugation Charts – Present, Past & Future PDF Reference Sheets
build_steps: Open Canva → search "academic chart" template → select clean grid layout
Add three separate tables for Present, Past and Future tenses, labeling each row with pronouns in Spanish
Set font to Noto Sans Spanish, test accent rendering, and color‑code each tense with pastel shades
Insert example verb conjugations (hablar, comer, vivir) and include a small usage tip box
Export as PDF Print → upload to Etsy as a digital download
products.what_to_build: Three double‑sided PDF pages, each a full conjugation chart for all regular and common irregular verbs in present, past and future; learners use them to reference and practice verb forms while writing or speaking.
products.why_it_sells: Busy Spanish students and teachers buy it for quick classroom reference or self‑study, and the clear pastel design makes it a high‑click Etsy listing.

products.etsy_title: Spanish 200-Word Intermediate Vocabulary Flashcards – Printable PDF Study Set
build_steps: Open Canva → search "flashcard" template → choose minimalist pastel style
Create 200 cards, front side with the Spanish word in Noto Serif, back side with English translation and example sentence
Group words by theme (travel, emotions, daily routine) and add small icon for each category
Apply a consistent color border, verify accent marks display correctly in Noto Serif
Export as PDF Print (double‑sided) → list on Etsy as a digital download

products.why_it_sells: Intermediate learners need fresh vocabulary for exams and conversation, and the ready‑to‑print format with themed groups drives fast Etsy sales.
